title: Carrot Salad Lettuce Wraps with Hard-Boiled Eggs, Mayo & Capers

steps.text: Place eggs in a medium saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemons into a medium bowl. Add oil, honey, Dijon, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Peel and halve the eggs. Season with salt.
Place mayo, water, and additional salt in a small bowl. Whisk to combine.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with carrot salad and eggs. Spoon mayo sauce over eggs, top with capers, and season with pepper. Enjoy!
